policies.name: data-proxy: M1 Worker issues
policies.description: A new Workers Issue: an uncaught exception, failed invocation, 5xx response or ERROR line in source-data-proxy. See ADR-015, Monitors.

policies.name: data-proxy: M2 Error-rate SLO
policies.description: Fewer than 99.9% of product requests succeeded (status < 500) over both the last 10 minutes and the last hour. See ADR-015, Monitors.

selectors:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "value"
FROM "events"."analyticsEngine"."source_data_proxy_production"
WHERE (("accountTag" = '1335bb5b87a1c2e1de2ca03408c23b71') AND ("double2" >= 500))

policies.name: data-proxy: M3 Access denied
policies.description: More than 0.5% of product requests answered 403 over 15 minutes (normally at most 0.05%): the Source API or a bucket is refusing the proxy. 404s are left out because missing keys are routine for some products. See ADR-015, Monitors.

selectors:
SELECT countIf("double2" = 403) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS "value"
FROM "events"."analyticsEngine"."source_data_proxy_production"
WHERE ("accountTag" = '1335bb5b87a1c2e1de2ca03408c23b71')

policies.name: data-proxy: M6 Credential exchange failures
policies.description: More than 50 WARN/ERROR lines on /.sts in 10 minutes, excluding rate-limited refusals (normally none): users and the CLI may not be getting credentials. See ADR-015, Monitors.

selectors:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "value"
FROM "logs"."workersLogs"
WHERE (("accountTag" = '1335bb5b87a1c2e1de2ca03408c23b71') AND ("scriptName" = 'source-data-proxy') AND ("url" LIKE '%/.sts%') AND ("level" = 'warn' OR "level" = 'error') AND ("message" NOT LIKE '%rate_limited%'))

policies.name: data-proxy: M7 Latency
policies.description: p99 duration of GET and HEAD product requests above 5 s over 15 minutes (normally ~0.9 s). Uploads are left out: their p99 is ~6.5 s in normal operation. See ADR-015, Monitors.

selectors:
SELECT quantileWeighted(0.99, "double3", "sampleInterval") AS "value"
FROM "events"."analyticsEngine"."source_data_proxy_production"
WHERE (("accountTag" = '1335bb5b87a1c2e1de2ca03408c23b71') AND ("blob4" = 'GET' OR "blob4" = 'HEAD'))

policies.name: data-proxy: M8 Analytics rows
policies.description: Fewer than 50,000 Analytics Engine rows in 15 minutes (normally ~480,000): the ANALYTICS binding stopped writing, or traffic collapsed. See ADR-015, Monitors.

policies.name: data-proxy: M5 Cloudflare incidents
policies.description: Cloudflare has declared a major or critical incident. Context for M2/M4 alerts. See ADR-015, Monitors.
